name: ai-enterprise-studio
description: AI Enterprise Studio - A fully functional multimedia collaboration platform

scripts.build:studio: mkdir -p dist/studio && cp public/index.html dist/studio/ && cp public/styles.css dist/studio/ && cp configs/config.studio.js dist/studio/config.js
scripts.build:lobby: mkdir -p dist/lobby && cp public/index.html dist/lobby/ && cp public/styles.css dist/lobby/ && cp configs/config.lobby.js dist/lobby/config.js
scripts.build:mainstage: mkdir -p dist/mainstage && cp public/index.html dist/mainstage/ && cp public/styles.css dist/mainstage/ && cp configs/config.mainstage.js dist/mainstage/config.js
scripts.deploy:studio: npm run build:studio && FIREBASE_JSON=firebase.studio.json firebase deploy --only hosting --project studio
scripts.deploy:lobby: npm run build:lobby && FIREBASE_JSON=firebase.lobby.json firebase deploy --only hosting --project lobby
scripts.deploy:mainstage: npm run build:mainstage && FIREBASE_JSON=firebase.mainstage.json firebase deploy --only hosting --project mainstage
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:studio && npm run deploy:lobby && npm run deploy:mainstage
